meanings.en: in the same way throughout; consistently
meanings.exampleEn: The paint was applied uniformly across the wall.
meanings.exampleTr: Boya duvarın her yerine eşit biçimde uygulandı.

meanings.en: in a way that is not equal or balanced
meanings.exampleEn: The wealth was distributed unevenly among the regions.
meanings.exampleTr: Zenginlik bölgeler arasında eşit olmayan biçimde dağıtıldı.

meanings.en: not precise or accurate
meanings.exampleEn: His description of the events was rather inexact.
meanings.exampleTr: Olaylara dair anlatımı oldukça kesinlikten uzaktı.

meanings.en: a person who evaluates or judges something
meanings.exampleEn: The assessor reviewed the property to determine its value.
meanings.exampleTr: Değerlendirici, değerini belirlemek için mülkü inceledi.

meanings.en: a person or device that tests something
meanings.exampleEn: The software tester found several bugs in the program.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılım test edicisi programda birkaç hata buldu.

meanings.en: the state of being better or greater than others
meanings.exampleEn: The team's superiority was clear by the final score.
meanings.exampleTr: Takımın üstünlüğü maç sonucundan açıkça belliydi.

meanings.en: the quality of being average or ordinary
meanings.exampleEn: He refused to settle for mediocrity in his work.
meanings.exampleTr: İşinde vasatlığa razı olmayı reddetti.

meanings.en: the state of being lower in quality or status
meanings.exampleEn: He struggled with a deep sense of inferiority.
meanings.exampleTr: Derin bir aşağılık duygusuyla mücadele etti.

meanings.en: an excessive quantity of something
meanings.exampleEn: There was an overabundance of food at the festival.
meanings.exampleTr: Festivalde aşırı bir yiyecek bolluğu vardı.

meanings.en: including everything or everyone
meanings.exampleEn: The school promotes an inclusive environment for all students.
meanings.exampleTr: Okul, tüm öğrenciler için kapsayıcı bir ortam teşvik eder.

meanings.en: extremely tired or no longer usable
meanings.exampleEn: After the long hike, I felt completely worn out.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yürüyüşten sonra kendimi tamamen bitkin hissettim.

meanings.en: feeling energetic again after rest
meanings.exampleEn: She woke up feeling refreshed after a good night's sleep.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi bir gece uykusunun ardından dinlenmiş olarak uyandı.

meanings.en: the state of not existing
meanings.exampleEn: The philosopher debated the nonexistence of the soul.
meanings.exampleTr: Filozof ruhun yokluğunu tartıştı.

meanings.en: a means of escape from a difficult situation
meanings.exampleEn: She was looking for a way out of her financial troubles.
meanings.exampleTr: Mali sıkıntılarından bir çıkış yolu arıyordu.

meanings.en: to make or become bigger
meanings.exampleEn: They decided to enlarge the kitchen during the renovation.
meanings.exampleTr: Tadilat sırasında mutfağı büyütmeye karar verdiler.

meanings.en: the act of spending money or resources
meanings.exampleEn: The government reduced its expenditure on defense.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet savunmaya yaptığı harcamayı azalttı.

meanings.en: experienced and skilled through long practice
meanings.exampleEn: A seasoned traveler knows how to pack light.
meanings.exampleTr: Tecrübeli bir gezgin hafif bavul hazırlamayı bilir.

meanings.en: the act of exploding with great force
meanings.exampleEn: The detonation of the bomb shook the entire building.
meanings.exampleTr: Bombanın patlaması tüm binayı salladı.

meanings.en: a violent collapse inward
meanings.exampleEn: The implosion of the old stadium took only seconds.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski stadyumun içe çökmesi yalnızca birkaç saniye sürdü.

meanings.en: to make something last longer
meanings.exampleEn: The treatment may prolong his life by several years.
meanings.exampleTr: Tedavi hayatını birkaç yıl uzatabilir.

meanings.en: to make something shorter
meanings.exampleEn: Can you shorten the report to one page?
meanings.exampleTr: Raporu bir sayfaya kısaltabilir misin?

meanings.en: became extinct or disappeared completely
meanings.exampleEn: Many species died out during the ice age.
meanings.exampleTr: Buzul çağında birçok tür yok oldu.

meanings.en: still in existence; surviving
meanings.exampleEn: Only a few extant copies of the manuscript remain.
meanings.exampleTr: El yazmasının yalnızca birkaç mevcut nüshası kaldı.

meanings.en: gradually becoming extinct or disappearing
meanings.exampleEn: Traditional crafts are slowly dying out in the region.
meanings.exampleTr: Geleneksel zanaatlar bölgede yavaş yavaş yok oluyor.

meanings.en: sports involving high risk and excitement
meanings.exampleEn: He loves adventure sports like rock climbing and skydiving.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaya tırmanışı ve paraşütle atlama gibi macera sporlarını sever.

meanings.en: physically present rather than remotely
meanings.exampleEn: I prefer to discuss this in person rather than by email.
meanings.exampleTr: Bunu e-posta yerine şahsen konuşmayı tercih ederim.

meanings.en: from a distance, not physically present
meanings.exampleEn: Many employees now work remotely from home.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok çalışan artık evden uzaktan çalışıyor.

meanings.en: happening with people physically present
meanings.exampleEn: The company resumed in-person meetings after the pandemic.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket pandemiden sonra yüz yüze toplantılara yeniden başladı.

meanings.en: a useful or pleasant feature of a place
meanings.exampleEn: The hotel offers many amenities, including a pool and gym.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel havuz ve spor salonu dahil birçok olanak sunuyor.

meanings.en: the act of setting up equipment for use
meanings.exampleEn: The installation of the new software took two hours.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yazılımın kurulumu iki saat sürdü.

meanings.en: to make or become lighter or happier
meanings.exampleEn: A few flowers can brighten any room.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç çiçek herhangi bir odayı aydınlatabilir.

meanings.en: to make or become stronger or more extreme
meanings.exampleEn: The storm began to intensify in the afternoon.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtına öğleden sonra şiddetlenmeye başladı.

meanings.en: not loyal, especially to a partner
meanings.exampleEn: He was unfaithful to his wife throughout their marriage.
meanings.exampleTr: Evlilikleri boyunca eşine sadakatsizdi.

meanings.en: made in imitation to deceive; fake
meanings.exampleEn: The police seized a large amount of counterfeit money.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis büyük miktarda sahte para ele geçirdi.

meanings.en: let something fall or abandoned it
meanings.exampleEn: She accidentally dropped her phone on the floor.
meanings.exampleTr: Telefonunu yanlışlıkla yere düşürdü.

meanings.en: brought down or knocked to the ground
meanings.exampleEn: The storm downed several power lines in the area.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtına bölgede birkaç elektrik hattını yere indirdi.

meanings.en: upright on the feet; permanent or ongoing
meanings.exampleEn: There is a standing invitation for you to visit us anytime.
meanings.exampleTr: Bizi istediğin zaman ziyaret etmen için kalıcı bir davetimiz var.

meanings.en: the act of leaving or separating from someone
meanings.exampleEn: Their parting at the station was emotional.
meanings.exampleTr: İstasyondaki ayrılıkları duygusaldı.

meanings.en: land used for growing crops
meanings.exampleEn: Much of the region's cropland is used for wheat.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölgenin ekili arazisinin çoğu buğday için kullanılıyor.

meanings.en: at a closer distance
meanings.exampleEn: Move your chair nearer to the table.
meanings.exampleTr: Sandalyeni masaya daha yakın çek.

meanings.en: at or to a shorter distance
meanings.exampleEn: We need to look closer at the details.
meanings.exampleTr: Ayrıntılara daha yakından bakmamız gerekiyor.

meanings.en: a male member of the clergy
meanings.exampleEn: The clergyman led the congregation in prayer.
meanings.exampleTr: Din adamı cemaate dua ettirdi.

meanings.en: in a secondary or less important way
meanings.exampleEn: The course focuses on grammar and secondarily on vocabulary.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurs dilbilgisine ve ikincil olarak kelime bilgisine odaklanıyor.

meanings.en: a school for children in the first grades
meanings.exampleEn: My daughter started elementary school this year.
meanings.exampleTr: Kızım bu yıl ilkokula başladı.

meanings.en: relating to the earliest ages; ancient
meanings.exampleEn: The explorers walked through a primeval forest.
meanings.exampleTr: Kâşifler ilkel bir ormanın içinden yürüdüler.

meanings.en: in a natural or raw state; rough and unrefined
meanings.exampleEn: The factory processes crude oil into fuel.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika ham petrolü yakıta dönüştürüyor.

meanings.en: a prison for people convicted of serious crimes
meanings.exampleEn: He spent ten years in a state penitentiary.
meanings.exampleTr: On yılını bir eyalet hapishanesinde geçirdi.

meanings.en: a person confined in a prison or institution
meanings.exampleEn: Each inmate is allowed one hour of exercise per day.
meanings.exampleTr: Her mahkûma günde bir saat egzersiz izni veriliyor.

meanings.en: the state of being private and away from others
meanings.exampleEn: The writer sought seclusion to finish her novel.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazar romanını bitirmek için inzivaya çekildi.

meanings.en: the state of being alone, often by choice
meanings.exampleEn: She enjoys the solitude of early morning walks.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabahın erken saatlerindeki yürüyüşlerin yalnızlığından keyif alır.

meanings.en: the chance that something will happen
meanings.exampleEn: There is a strong likelihood of rain tomorrow.
meanings.exampleTr: Yarın yağmur yağma olasılığı yüksek.

meanings.en: the quality of being unlikely to happen
meanings.exampleEn: Despite the improbability of success, they kept trying.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarının ihtimal düşüklüğüne rağmen denemeye devam ettiler.

meanings.en: producing good or useful results
meanings.exampleEn: The two leaders had a fruitful discussion about peace.
meanings.exampleTr: İki lider barış konusunda verimli bir görüşme yaptı.

meanings.en: not producing useful results
meanings.exampleEn: The meeting was long and completely unproductive.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı uzun ve tamamen verimsizdi.

meanings.en: the act of forbidding something
meanings.exampleEn: The forbiddance of smoking improved air quality in the building.
meanings.exampleTr: Sigara yasaklaması binadaki hava kalitesini iyileştirdi.

meanings.en: a reduction to a lower rank or position
meanings.exampleEn: His poor performance led to a demotion.
meanings.exampleTr: Kötü performansı rütbesinin indirilmesine yol açtı.

meanings.en: things that someone owns
meanings.exampleEn: They packed all their possessions into a single van.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm eşyalarını tek bir minibüse sığdırdılar.

meanings.en: used to protect against attack or criticism
meanings.exampleEn: He became defensive when asked about his mistakes.
meanings.exampleTr: Hataları sorulunca savunmacı bir tavır takındı.

meanings.en: keeping someone or something safe from harm
meanings.exampleEn: The dog is very good at protecting the house.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek evi korumakta çok başarılı.

meanings.en: to prove that something is false
meanings.exampleEn: The new evidence helped to disprove the theory.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni kanıt teoriyi çürütmeye yardımcı oldu.

meanings.en: a well-known short expression of wisdom
meanings.exampleEn: There is an old saying that honesty is the best policy.
meanings.exampleTr: Dürüstlüğün en iyi yol olduğuna dair eski bir deyiş vardır.

meanings.en: a traditional saying expressing a common truth
meanings.exampleEn: The old adage says that time heals all wounds.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski atasözü zamanın tüm yaraları iyileştirdiğini söyler.

meanings.en: a place where alcohol is served
meanings.exampleEn: They stopped at a small tavern for a drink.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir içki içmek için küçük bir meyhanede durdular.

meanings.en: a system of buses and trains for the public
meanings.exampleEn: Many people use public transit to get to work.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok kişi işe gitmek için toplu taşımayı kullanır.

meanings.en: a young dog
meanings.exampleEn: The little pup chased its tail in the garden.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük yavru köpek bahçede kuyruğunu kovaladı.

meanings.en: not mixed with anything else; pure
meanings.exampleEn: The success brought him unmixed joy.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarı ona katıksız bir sevinç getirdi.

meanings.en: mixed with unwanted substances; not pure
meanings.exampleEn: The water was impure and unsafe to drink.
meanings.exampleTr: Su saf değildi ve içmek için güvenli değildi.

meanings.en: to make something thoroughly clean
meanings.exampleEn: Use this lotion to cleanse your skin every morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Cildini her sabah temizlemek için bu losyonu kullan.

meanings.en: to push roughly
meanings.exampleEn: He tried to shove his way through the crowd.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalığın arasından ite kaka geçmeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: to push suddenly and forcefully
meanings.exampleEn: She thrust the letter into his hand and left.
meanings.exampleTr: Mektubu eline tutuşturup gitti.
